title: Osteoporosis: bone strength, fractures and risk exposures
sec: Osteoporosis: bone strength, fractures and risk exposures · p895
guide: Bone strength includes quantity and microarchitecture; trabecular loss is emphasized. Know fragility-fracture sites, postmenopausal risks and medication associations. Source-specific frequency/site claims are not universal epidemiology.

title: Secondary causes, DXA scores and treatment selection
sec: Secondary causes, DXA scores and treatment selection · p896
guide: Map secondary causes by system, then interpret DXA against young-adult or age-matched references. T ≤−2.5 is the diagnostic threshold in appropriate adults. Z-scores remain useful; FRAX is a calculated fracture probability, not directly measured by DXA.

title: Osteoporosis: antiresorptive and anabolic therapy
sec: Osteoporosis: antiresorptive and anabolic therapy · p897
guide: Pair treatments with mechanisms, administration and adverse effects. Separate book-era rankings and investigational drugs from current prescribing. The ibandronate route/dose line contains a significant error and is explicitly corrected.
